integrity: The proof is analytic for arbitrary part sizes. Finite exhaustive checks are corroborative only. Literature overlap was assessed against the initiating preprint, targeted searches, and the current owned ledger; a poorly indexed equivalent result remains a residual risk.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns noncomplete complete multipartite graphs with at least three parts. It does not replace the published complete-bipartite formula or claim novelty for the already-known complete-graph case.
title: Total outer-independent coalition number of noncomplete multipartite graphs with at least three parts
